result:
The frontend-dev phase-02 (Polish) passes on attempt 1: all 9 checks passed, no questions.

This phase has no acceptance criteria of its own, so I wrote a test plan from its goal, its two tasks (T006, T007) and its review:
- **C1–C6:** the six tag checks from phase-01 (AC-US1-1 to AC-US1-6), run again unchanged in the UI with Playwright (headless). Adding tags, filtering by "work", removing a tag, rejecting empty, 31-character and 11th tags, and treating "Work"/"WORK" as "work" all behave as in phase-01. The API returns the same tags the page shows.
- **C7:** the page matches the UI contract:
  - the tag filter is labelled "Tag" and is disabled in the Overdue view;
  - a task with no tags still shows its tags container;
  - the add input's placeholder reads "Add tags, comma-separated" and the button reads "Add tag";
  - each remove button shows "×" with the label "Remove tag <tag>".
- **C8:** pressing Enter in the tag input adds the tag, shows "Tags added" and empties the input.
- **C9:** the build log `phase-02-build.log` shows a finished build with no errors.
- **Unit tests:** none are configured for the frontend, so there was nothing to run.

The browser console shows the three expected 400 errors from the rejected adds, plus one error I caused myself. My first attempt to create the test tasks called the backend on port 8080 directly and was blocked by CORS; the retry through the app worked. That error doesn't come from the app.

The one requirement no check here covers is BR-T4: a task's tags are deleted with the task. Nothing in this phase deals with deleting; the backend-dev phase-01 unit tests cover it.
